 Nine women's singles matches are scheduled for the Round of 32 at the Ningbo Open on October 19 at the Yinzhou International Tennis Centre in Ningbo, China. According to The New York Times, the hard-court tournament features several ranked players, including Elise Mertens and Leylah Annie Fernandez, who are scheduled to meet early in the day's program.
 Mertens, ranked No. 15, is set to face Fernandez, ranked No. 30, at 12:05 a.m. ET. The tournament schedule also includes matchups involving Sorana Cirstea, Daria Kasatkina, Alexandra Eala and Jasmine Paolini.

 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 The event takes place on hard courts at the Yinzhou International Tennis Centre. The published schedule lists nine matches across different start times, with four contests scheduled for 10 p.m. ET.

 Osaka Open Opens With Krueger and Tjen Among First-Round Matches 
 The opening match between Mertens and Fernandez is scheduled for 12:05 a.m. ET, followed by Sorana Cirstea against Han Shi at 1:15 a.m. ET.
 Daria Kasatkina is scheduled to play Aliaksandra Sasnovich at 4 a.m. ET, while Kamilla Rakhimova faces Marie Bouzkova at 5:10 a.m. ET.
 Alexandra Eala is scheduled to meet Diane Parry at 7:30 a.m. ET. These matches form the earlier portion of the Round of 32 program listed in the tournament's published schedule.
 Also Read 
 Samsonova Faces Tagger in WTA Osaka Round of 32 
 The remaining four matches are scheduled for 10 p.m. ET. Yulia Putintseva is set to play Diana Shnaider, Jasmine Paolini will face Anhelina Kalinina, Cristina Bucsa will meet Polina Kudermetova, and Katarzyna Kawa is scheduled to play Daria Snigur.
 The New York Times published the schedule on October 18, 2026, ahead of the following day's matches. The report identifies the event as the Ningbo Open and lists the Yinzhou International Tennis Centre in Ningbo, China, as the venue.
